Mission: We are looking for a French-speaking Test Automation Engineer to join our growing team. In this role, you will contribute to ensuring the quality, stability, and reliability of our software applications, with a primary focus on test automation while also supporting manual testing activities.
 Important: Please note that this is a project-based role with an expected duration of nine months.
Define and drive the test automation strategy for the assigned scope.
Take ownership of the test repository, ensuring its quality, structure, and maintainability.
Monitor and report testing progress, track defects and anomalies, and provide relevant test evidence.
Plan, implement, execute, and maintain test campaigns.
Ensure the functional quality of each delivered increment.
Assess and contribute to the testability of backlog items.
Promote technical and methodological excellence in testing practices.
Work closely with testers across Tribe Squads, Product Managers, Product Owners, Chapter Leads, and Tribe IT Leads.
Collaborate with the Center of Expertise to share knowledge and ensure alignment with testing standards.
Advanced level of French, both written and spoken.
Previous experience working in an Agile environment.
Good knowledge of Java programming.
Hands-on experience with test automation tools, particularly Selenium for web applications.
Experience with API testing tools such as Postman or Bruno.
Familiarity with test management tools
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with business stakeholders, developers, and Product Owners.
Strong collaboration and teamwork skills.
Analytical and critical thinking, combined with a proactive mindset and initiative.
Good organizational, planning, and time management abilities.
 Nice To Have
ISTQB certification.
Previous experience working on financial services projects
